race.description: Maitland Rugby Club Maitland Cup Conditional Hcp (Bm68)
race.comment: COMMANDING ARTIST (3) tackled a better race than this when fresh from a spell last time out over 1350m here and was safely held in fifth. Needs the extra 150m now and won't spend a cent out of the inside alley. Poses a serious threat. JACENZA (6) scored convincingly here in a 1500m BM64 two back then led but was swamped in the Coonamble Cup over a mile more recently. In the mix back in this company. UNREACHABLE (8) put the writing on the wall last time and will enjoy getting to this distance. ALABAMA BLITZ (7) could be ready to peak after improving to place last start.
